problem_type: Late asynchronous writes lose their original content owner
symptom: A model catalog lookup can write a pending plan into another document or overwrite a newer draft.
direct_cause: The proposal writer reads activeDocumentId after await and does not compare the original plan or loaded canvas.
class_root: The shared asynchronous write boundary lacks captured target and content identity.
affected_population: Existing storyboard proposal callers with visual references
Projects replaced while catalog lookup is pending
internal_only_reason: Application write ownership is independent of the model catalog implementation.
invariants: Await never retargets a write to current focus
A late result never replaces content edited after it started
Loaded canvas replacement invalidates pending writes

door_reduction.why_not: Production materialization, multishot landing, row execution, proposal admission and onboarding retain distinct callers; all already converge on applyCanvasToolCall. Synchronous editor, override and table writes retain their existing owner. Only the existing asynchronous storyboard operation is changed.

generality_proof: Document focus, source edits, explicit plan edits and project replacement are validated at the existing shared writer before mutation, regardless of caller or catalog model.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Capture the original document and explicit plan and compare them before the existing write.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Proposal transaction reaches the same captured-target writer.
Existing row materialization creates nodes, not the asynchronous storyboard proposal operation.

recurrence.reason: Any asynchronous catalog lookup permits navigation or newer authoring before completion.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs applyCanvasToolCall: five direct callers
node scripts/door-map.mjs setStoryboardPlan: five write and one read entries
Inspected project save queue ownedPayload and proposal beforeApply guards

prevention.invariant: An existing proposal writes only its captured live content owner.
prevention.failure_mode: Stale project or changed content rejects with capability_target_stale before mutation.
prevention.strategy: Capture before await; compare immutable content and existing canvas lifecycle before committing.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removes after-await fallback to current document; no new legacy Agent writer is introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Zustand immutable state and canvas generation identity own this application invariant.

residual_risks: Run-to-creation authoring owner gap is separate and is not fixed by this guard.
Provider and packaged application acceptance are not established by unit tests.
